in case that , otherwise , the result of such checking is negative , i.e. your condition as resident can not be confirmed this automatic way , you will need to show at the airport an original certificate of residence , duly issued by your city countil or , if you are a member of the spanish parliament -lrb- congreso de los diputados o senado -rrb- , the corresponding certificate as such .
